question.question: What specific location in Tokyo does Calvin mention being excited to explore?

evidence_items.text:
Calvin: Yes, Dave! That was an incredible experience to visit similar streets like you shared in your photo. Is there anything else that interests you in Tokyo?
[S24T13] (dia_id: D24:13)

Dave: Of course, Calvin! Tokyo is amazing! I want to know everything about it - the people, the culture, the food, take a walk at the vibrant city life! In the photo below, the city is so alive and colorful that's impressive! It will be an unforgettable experience!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowded street at night with people walking and walking]
[S24T14] (dia_id: D24:14)

Calvin: That photo's a great pic! The lights, the people - so lively! Can't wait to hear your emotions when you see that in person!
[S24T15] (dia_id: D24:15)

Dave: It's really amazing. Hope I'll get to see it in person soon!
[S24T16] (dia_id: D24:16)

Calvin: Cool, Dave! I'm actually going to Tokyo next month after the tour ends. Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like the one in the photo below. What a great view!
[Image caption: a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background]
[S24T17] (dia_id: D24:17)

Dave: Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear! Any specific spots in Tokyo that you're really excited to check out?
[S24T18] (dia_id: D24:18)

Calvin: Yeah definitely! Shibuya Crossing is like Tokyo's Times Square, and I was excited to explore Shinjuku. Plus, there's amazing food there, can't wait to try it again! Look at the photo of Shibuya Crossing at night, that's amazing!
[Image caption: a photo of a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain]
[S24T19] (dia_id: D24:19)

Dave: Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! The food in Tokyo is great, I'll have so much fun exploring all the different places. Have you tried ramen yet? Here's a photo of a ramen bowl that I tried in Boston, it was delicious, but i think in Tokyo it will be even better!
[Image caption: a photo of a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles]
[S24T20] (dia_id: D24:20)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Never tried it, but it's supposed to be awesome. Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!
[S24T21] (dia_id: D24:21)

Dave: Do it, Calvin! Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!
[S24T22] (dia_id: D24:22)

Calvin: Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely give it a shot. Appreciate the encouragement! See you soon, bye!
[S24T23] (dia_id: D24:23)

- The 2023-10-15 conversation continued: Dave said The Fireworks headlined the festival (answering Calvin's question); Calvin: "Wow, I heard great things about The Fireworks! Performing with Frank Ocean recently has been really cool. Seeing them perform live must've been awesome - I bet the energy was electric. That's why I love my job so much - connecting with the crowd." (Calvin's "recently" — the Frank Ocean tour he described to Dave on 2023-08-14 as having ended with the Tokyo show — suggests more recent performances with Frank Ocean; not confirmed) [S23T9][S23T10]. Dave: "The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do." Calvin: "Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend." [S23T11][S23T12]. Dave thanked Calvin — his support "really helps," it's "great to have a friend who believes in me," and he'll "keep pushing" [S23T13]; Calvin: "I believe in you, Dave. Keep pushing and never forget how awesome you are." [S23T14]; Dave: "Your support means a lot. I'm gonna keep going and not forget my value!" [S23T15]. Calvin closed the chat urging Dave to "keep going for those dreams. You got this!" and announced, "Last week" (~2023-10-09/15), he got a new Ferrari — "a masterpiece on wheels" — and is excited for "thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys," sharing a photo of it (a black sports car parked in front of a building) — "Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood." (details in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26)) [S23T16]. The 2023-10-15 conversation then closed: Dave congratulated Calvin on the new Ferrari ("that's incredible! Must be one amazing ride"), said Calvin's positivity is contagious, and asked him to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready" and to "keep the good vibes rolling"; Calvin agreed the Ferrari "is indeed a showstopper" and said he'd "share a pic soon," and the two signed off "Here's to more thrilling rides and positive vibes... looking forward to catching up soon!" [S23T17][S23T18].
- On 2023-10-19, caught up with Dave ("Hey Dave! Been a few days since we talked, but lots happened."): told him he started touring with Frank Ocean and it's been amazing — "so much energy from the crowd, such a connection when I'm on stage - unreal!" — sharing a photo of how he performed on stage (a band performing on stage with bright lights) — "Take a look at how I performed on stage, that was awesome!"; Dave: "Congrats, Calvin! That's awesome. Being able to play your music to a crowd and feel that connection must be unreal. How's the tour going?"; Calvin: "The tour has been great, the energy from the crowd is awesome and jamming with Frank Ocean is a dream come true. It's been amazing!"; Dave: "I bet performing with him is like a dream come true! How did it happen?"; Calvin: "It all started August last year" (August 2022) "when we met at a festival and he said he wanted to collaborate. We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky!" — sharing a photo of the two of them on stage (a band performing on stage with a projection of a man on the wall) — "Check the photo, of how we perfectly look together on stage!" (tour and origin details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration); Dave: "Wow, Calvin - you and Frank are so in tune! It's clear you both rock on stage. Can't wait to catch your show!"; Calvin: "I'm so excited you'll be at one of our shows. It's such a great experience, you'll definitely enjoy it!" — sharing a photo of the audience (a large crowd of people in a large auditorium) — "Look at this crowd, that was insane!"; Dave: "That sounds really exciting! Can't wait to experience it. I'm sure everyone in the crowd is going to be pumped up!" [S24T1][S24T2][S24T3][S24T4][S24T5][S24T6][S24T7][S24T8].
- The 2023-10-19 conversation continued: Calvin announced he's actually going to Tokyo in November 2023 ("next month") after the tour ends, sharing a photo of a city at night with a tall building in the background — "Sometimes I wish I could go back to places like [that]. What a great view!"; Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's great to hear!" and asked any specific spots in Tokyo he's really excited to check out; Calvin: Shibuya Crossing — "like Tokyo's Times Square" — and he's "excited to explore Shinjuku," plus "amazing food there, can't wait to try it again!" — sharing a photo of Shibuya Crossing at night (a crowd of people with umbrellas in the rain) — "that's amazing!"; Dave: "Shibuya and Shinjuku are cool spots! The food in Tokyo is great, I'll have so much fun exploring all the different places." and asked whether Calvin has tried ramen, sharing a photo of a bowl of ramen (a bowl of soup with broccoli and noodles) he tried in Boston — "it was delicious, but I think in Tokyo it will be even better!"; Calvin: never tried ramen, but "it's supposed to be awesome" — "Gonna give it a shot while in Tokyo!"; Dave: "Do it, Calvin! Once you try it, you'll never go back. Bon voyage and have fun!"; the chat closed with Calvin: "Thanks, Dave! I'll definitely give it a shot. Appreciate the encouragement! See you soon, bye!" (Tokyo trip details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20); Dave's side in the 2023-10-19 entry of the Relationships section and the Japan section of /memories/dave.md) [S24T17][S24T18][S24T19][S24T20][S24T21][S24T22][S24T23].
- On 2023-10-23, caught up with Dave about the tour and fame: Dave opened by asking how the tour with Frank Ocean is going, noting he'd been "pondering our chat the other day about fame and its impact on relationships" (a chat not otherwise recorded in this memory) — "It must be awesome but it must have its own struggles too" — and how Calvin is juggling his job plus his personal life; Calvin: the tour's been incredible — performing and connecting with the crowd has been so energizing — but fame has its own challenges and it's been tough trying to balance everything [S25T1][S25T2]. Dave asked how he's managing and whether he ever feels overwhelmed; Calvin: he takes it one day at a time, but it can get overwhelming with so many demands — still, he enjoys what he does so he pushes on [S25T3][S25T4]. Dave asked for strategies, and Calvin: a strong support system is really helpful — his friends and team keep him on track [S25T5][S25T6]. Dave then shared that he recently had a good conversation with some neighbors about current events and politics — it was nice to hear different perspectives and share their own, and interacting like that cheers him up and helps him stay informed — and asked Calvin the same (Dave's side in the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: staying connected and up-to-date on world events is important to him — it helps his music stand out by incorporating unique perspectives, connects him better with his fans, and keeps him motivated and inspired [S25T7][S25T8]. The conversation then turned to art (Dave: "Art is amazing how it reflects the world"): asked whether anything caught Calvin's eye lately and impacted his music; Calvin: yes — recently he's been really inspired by the struggles that people go through, which has made him dig deeper into his music to try to capture those feelings [S25T9][S25T10]. Dave asked whether using his music to share experiences and feelings is cathartic for him; Calvin: yes — it's a way for him to express himself and work through his emotions — "like my own form of therapy" [S25T11][S25T12]. Dave agreed ("I get it"), saying cars give him an outlet to express himself — "like a little oasis of calm" — that working on a car is "like I'm connecting back with myself," and that the music helps too; he shared a photo of his garage (a little dirty, but everything in its place, tools hanging on the wall) [S25T13]. Calvin: "Looking cool — what made you start working on cars?"; Dave: ever since he was ten he's been fascinated with how machines work — he found an old car in a neighbor's garage, asked if he could fix it, and that's when his love for car engineering began — he enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment hooked him, so he's been working on cars ever since (shared a photo of a man working on a car in a garage) [S25T14][S25T15]. Calvin: "Impressive! That must have taken a lot of skill and determination to bring that car back to life," and asked whether it was a classic car and whether Dave still has it or is currently working on another project [S25T16]; Dave answered in the continuation of the chat: "Thanks Calvin! It was a fun project. I restored a car last year, but I sold it to a collector" (Dave's 2022 restoration — details in the Classic cars section of /memories/dave.md), and he's "now working on something new, and it's quite a challenge!" — sharing a photo of his new project car (a black car parked in a parking lot — "Take a look at this wonderful car!") [S25T17]. Calvin: "Cool! Been wanting to try that. What would you say is the toughest part of car restoration?" — Dave: it takes a lot of patience but the payoff is worth it, and paying extra attention to detail isn't easy but it pays off (details in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T18][S25T19]. Calvin: details "can really make a difference" and are what makes something great — "like a well-crafted rap song or a sleek and stylish car" [S25T20]; Dave: paying attention to details "makes a big difference, whether it's in music or with vehicles" — little things can make a big impact [S25T21]. Calvin: without those details it's just average, and as an artist he wants to create something extraordinary — sharing a photo of his record (a silver disc in a black frame on a table; his side in the Music section of this file) [S25T22]; Dave: he loves the attention to detail in Calvin's work — "it makes it extra special. Keep on creating!" — sharing a photo of his brown amp (a brown amp with a black knob and a brown cover; Dave's side in the Music section of /memories/dave.md) [S25T23]; Calvin: "Thanks Dave! Appreciate your support!" [S25T24]. The chat then turned to concerts: Dave, glad that Calvin liked his garage, said the good times he's had at concerts last month (~September 2023) remind him that "music has a way of connecting us and making memories" — "Take a look at this picture, the atmosphere was amazing!" (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Calvin: "Music has a way of bringing us together and creating unforgettable memories. It's unbeatable in terms of the energy it brings" (shared a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air); Dave: "Concerts are awesome, they bring people together and create such a cool vibe. You can feel the energy in the air." — sharing another photo from a concert (a crowd of people standing around a stage — "this unforgettable moment that I captured"); Calvin: "Concerts are what I live for - the indescribable connection between the artist and the crowd is just amazing!" [S25T25][S25T26][S25T27][S25T28]; Dave: "Wow, it's amazing how that connection between artist and crowd can be indescribable. So glad you get to experience that!" [S25T29]; Calvin: "It's a rush connecting with everyone. That feeling is unbeatable! Wishing you a harmonious day ahead, my friend!" [S25T30]; Dave: "I can imagine it's a rush being up on stage with all the fans cheering. Must be a unique experience. Wishing you many more electrifying moments in the spotlight! See you soon!" — the conversation closed [S25T31].
- On 2023-10-25, reconnected with Dave ("Long time no talk!"): told Dave he had a great time the day before (2023-10-24), visiting some sights in Boston with a high school friend — "It was really fun and eye-opening" (details in ## Boston trip); Dave: "Good to hear from you! Sounds like you had a blast in Boston - so much to do there!" and mentioned one of his favorites in Boston that's "great for chilling and admiring nature" (his Boston parks — details in the Boston and Parks sections of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "I had a wonderful experience during my time in Boston. It had awesome architecture and a really cool history. I followed your advice and went there, it was so peaceful." [S26T1][S26T2][S26T3]. Dave then told Calvin he recently attended a conference in Detroit — "it was so cool, I learned a lot" (details in the Car workshops in San Francisco section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "Good to hear that you've learned a lot of new things at the conference in Detroit!" [S26T2][S26T3]. The chat then turned to Dave's latest car project — he shared a photo (a group of people washing a car in a garage) and said working on this "takes me out of my head and calms me down" (details in the Hobbies and sense of purpose section of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "Dave, that car looks awesome! What got you into engineering cars? I'm totally into cars too and love making new and powerful models." (details in ## Music) [S26T4][S26T5]. Dave answered that cars have "always been my thing": his dad took him to his first car show when he was 10, he was "wow-ed" and "hooked," and wanted to learn more — now he's an automotive engineer, and it's "crazy to think that something so powerful and cool can be made from small parts" (details in the Classic cars and Hobbies and sense of purpose sections of /memories/dave.md); Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! So happy you followed your dreams and became an engineer. Seeing you work on cars is inspiring - it makes me want to keep pushing my music." — and shared a photo of himself performing in a nightclub (a DJ at a DJ table) with someone he admires — "Check this out ... So amazing!" (details in ## Music) [S26T6][S26T7]. Dave: "Wow, Calvin! That's amazing! You looked super comfortable on stage. Bet it was an incredible experience to perform with someone you admire. How did it feel being up there?" [S26T8]. Calvin: being "up there with someone I admire" was "unreal" — "a dream come true" — and the energy and the crowd made him realize how much music means to him — "it's like my passion and my purpose" (Calvin's side in ## Music) [S26T9]. Dave: "That's great, Calvin. We both have discovered something that brings us fulfillment. It's a fortunate thing for us." [S26T10]. Calvin: it's awesome to find something that makes them happy — it's fulfilling and motivating too — and he's glad they're "on this journey together" and curious to see what happens next [S26T11]. Dave: "Me too, Calvin! Let's see where it takes us. We can keep inspiring each other!" [S26T12]. Calvin: let's "keep inspiring each other to be our best selves" and urges Dave to "keep going for your passion, buddy" [S26T13]; Dave: "Thanks, Calvin! Same to you! Keep pursuing your passion and keep dreaming. We got this!" [S26T14]; the chat closed with Calvin thanking Dave for his support and saying they'll "keep pushing for our goals" — "Catch you later, see ya!" and Dave: "Got to go, see you soon!" [S26T15].
